column1: # Fixture for L5 provenance (MDD check 24 / risk R6). The producer claims it
# emitted 100 records and that none were dropped, but only two rows exist.
# rows + dropped (2) != source_rows (100), so E-L5-DIVERGE must fire. This is the
# signature of a truncated export, which is why the sum has to balance against an
# independently recorded total rather than the row count being taken on trust.
